record.one_liner: Enterprise CRM and deal-management platform for private equity, investment banking and advisory firms, with a REST Data API.
record.auth_notes: REST calls send an API key as a Bearer token. The key is enabled per user under Profile, after an admin grants the API capability. The Python SDK takes a site_url plus client_id and client_secret, but the docs do not say how those map to the REST token, so 'other' was not added. The MCP server uses OAuth 2.0, but that is the MCP layer, not the public REST API.
record.access_notes: No free or trial path was seen. API access needs the site's admin to enable the API capability for a user group, and users without the Admin section are told to contact their admin or the DealCloud Customer Success Manager. No pricing page was fetched, so this is inferred from the docs.
record.api_notes: The Data APIs cover create, read, update and delete on core objects such as deals, contacts and companies (entryLists), with a Cells view and a Swagger page per site. Breadth is judged from the Data API overview only.
record.blocker_notes: Credentials depend on a licensed DealCloud site and an admin granting the API capability. No self-serve developer sandbox was found.

evidence.quote: Scroll down to the API Key section and click Enable.
To enable API access, ensure the intended user is assigned to a user group with the appropriate permissions.
If you do not see the Admin section, contact your organization's admin or DealCloud Customer Success Manager (CSM) for assistance.
The Data APIs allow you to work with the core data within your DealCloud site, enabling you to create, retrieve, update, and delete records
DealCloud MCP uses OAuth to authenticate, letting AI assistants connect on behalf of an individual user.
